liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (4 reviews): Called one of the coolest 1970s versions; Brent gets funky and Bobby seems to tease the Ghostbusters theme; Recommended as one of two must-hear pieces if you skip the rest of the show [12][13][15][18]
- **Crowd / Take A Step Back / Weir's Quiz #1** (2 other sources): A tape flip after Weir's question leaves the answer missing; the Drums also have a crossfaded tape flip; A tape flip after Weir's question means the answer he gave is missing from this recording [1][2]
- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): The Estimated into Eyes pairing is singled out as a thrilling highlight; Estimated into Eyes, then drums, space and Truckin', is called unbelievable [13][21]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The transition out of China Cat into Rider got the reviewer hooked permanently [23]
- **Passenger** (1 review): Reviewer finds Passenger extremely hot [12]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Eyes follows Estimated Prophet and is played at a very fast tempo [12]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 other source): Wharf Rat is where a soundboard/audience patch occurs [3]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Set II closing sequence through Truckin' is described as fantastic [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-10-31.aud.glassberg.motb.87523.sbeok.flac24** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 191 min [1]. Said about its sound: From the start of one late track to the end of the show, the left channel was much quieter, then boosted [1]
- **gd1979-10-31.nakcm700-glassberg.motb39.egert-sirmick.86239.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 191 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Crowd enthusiasm at the start of China Cat nearly drowned the music, so a soundboard matrix covers 0:29 to 1:36 [2]
- **gd1979-10-31.sbd-bertha.ashley.17360.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 177 min; rated 4.43/5 by 7 [3]. Said about its sound: First set sounds like a different source from the second, and its channels were reversed before correction [3]
- **gd1979-10-31.sonyECM.moskal.mandel.96606.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 171 min [4]. Said about its sound: Levels fluctuate throughout, with some audience participation in spots and track cuts late in the show [4]
- **gd79-10-31.sbd-aud.shephard.9372.sbefail.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 169 min; rated 4.07/5 by 15 [9]

## Around the show

- The crowd is into it, and Jerry can be heard pleading with them to move back [21]
- Reviewer attended aged 16, stood in the second row, and found far too many people on the floor [23]
- Show is overshadowed by the preceding Cape Cod run and the other two nights of this run [16]
- Holds up as well as 11-2-79 and maybe better overall than 11-1-79, though that night's Scarlet>Fire is unreal [16]
- Reviewer says the band always stepped up its playing for Halloween shows [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-10-31.aud.glassberg.motb.87523.sbeok.flac24**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by A. Egert and SIRMick; source: Nakamichi CM-700's > Sony TC-158SD > MAC [1]. Also: Audience recording, edited with Audition, Sound Forge, Wavelab, iZotope Ozone and a BBE Sonic Maximizer [1]
- **gd1979-10-31.nakcm700-glassberg.motb39.egert-sirmick.86239.flac16**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by A. Egert; source: Nakamichi CM700's > Sony TCD5 > MAC 50ft. DFC Hand-Held [2]. Also: Soundboard used in the matrix went cassette master to reel to DAT to CD (shnid 29410) [2]
- **gd1979-10-31.sbd-bertha.ashley.17360.shnf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: Bertha Remaster of a combination of soundboard and audience sources see info file [3]. Also: Remastered April 3, 2003 with a custom dual-DAW nicknamed Bertha; the two sets were processed separately to match [3]
- **gd1979-10-31.sonyECM.moskal.mandel.96606.flac16**: taped by Gerry Moskal; transferred by Brian Mandel; source: Sony Stereo ECM -->SONY TCD126 Location: unknown; [4]. Also: Taped by Gerry; transferred from his reels in the mid-1980s during social tape trading; Gerry taped 11/2/79 behind stage right at 30 feet in the 300 section; this may match that location [4]
- **gd79-10-31.sbd-aud.shephard.9372.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard and Audience composite [9]. Also: Reviewer obtained an audience tape of this show in 1980, among their first tapes; Soundboard portions of this show have circulated for less time than those from other nights; Set 1 soundboard went cassette master to reel to DAT to CD; set 2 cassette master to cassette to DAT to CD [13][16][17]
